statements.quote: The 12% increase in total revenues in the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 compared to the prior fiscal year was primarily driven by higher product revenues resulting from increased leading-edge customer investments in foundry/logic, memory and advanced packaging technologies, supported by strong demand associated with AI and HPC applications.
statements.notes: 12% is the growth rate of total revenue, not AI's share of revenue. AI/HPC demand is cited as a supporting driver, and no AI revenue figure is stated.

statements.quote: Revenue from our Semiconductor Process Control segment increased 12% in fiscal 2026 compared to fiscal 2025, primarily due to increased revenue from foundry/logic and memory customers, driven by continued leading-edge investment supporting AI and HPC applications.
statements.notes: Segment revenue (Semiconductor Process Control), not company total. The 12% is growth, not an AI share. AI is cited as a driver of customer investment.
